def ov_mat(m,L,inp,outp,heads=range(4)):
    p=f'{m}.layers.{L}.'
    lin=1+weights[p+'input_layernorm.weight']; lpost=1+weights[p+'post_attention_layernorm.weight']
    Wv=weights[p+'self_attn.v_proj.weight']; Wo=weights[p+'self_attn.o_proj.weight']
    Ei=E[inp]*lin; Ei=Ei/np.sqrt((Ei**2).mean(1,keepdims=True))
    tot=0
    for h in heads:
        tot=tot+((Ei@Wv.T)@Wo[:,256*h:256*h+256].T*lpost*fn)@E[outp].T
    return tot

    p=f'{m}.layers.{L}.'

    p=f'{m}.layers.{L}.'
    lin=1+weights[p+'input_layernorm.weight']; lpost=1+weights[p+'post_attention_layernorm.weight']
    Wv=weights[p+'self_attn.v_proj.weight']; Wo=weights[p+'self_attn.o_proj.weight'][:,256*h:256*h+256]
    return (((E[inp]*lin)@Wv.T)@Wo.T*lpost*fn)@E[outp].T
